event_chain.summary: Use of stolen creds - employee password

summary: An attacker used a stolen employee password to break into City of North Platte and Lincoln County, Nebraska computer systems around Friday, October 9, 2026, coinciding with internet and phone outages at City Hall and the county courthouse. Systems were taken off the internet, Gov. Jim Pillen declared an emergency and activated the Nebraska National Guard cyber team. The mayor said residents' information was secure and no data was lost.
